entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, so are we boned if this[n]legal action goes through?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Madarame is a well-known[n]individual. The police will[n]surely move fast on his request.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We will be arrested, and worst[n]comes to worst, sent to some[n]sort of juvenile hall.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But I thought you said it[n]didn't seem like he'd actually[n]go through with it...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That is true. He's been[n]bedridden since we went[n]through with it, after all.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Honestly though, it's difficult[n]to even tell if he's actually[n]undergone a change of heart.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I guess we'll just have to[n]wait until he recovers...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I don't feel good about that...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I will contact you all at[n]once if anything happens.[n]Would that work for you?
Are you going to be OK?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Very well. I will try to keep[n]as close an eye on Madarame's[n]state as possible.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There have been no issues so far,[n]so I expect the same is true of[n]the future. Don't worry about me.
